literal: To those who renounced, sustenance desiring, did they forget, perhaps, the other people, penance?
translation: Perhaps other people forgot to perform penance themselves because they needed to provide sustenance to those who have renounced.
modern: துறந்தவர்களுக்கு உணவு மற்றும் உதவிகளைச் செய்ய வேண்டியிருப்பதால் தான், மற்றவர்கள் தவம் செய்வதை மறந்துவிட்டார்களோ?
explanation: This couplet highlights the essential relationship between householders and ascetics. The poet rhetorically asks if ordinary people forgot to perform penance because they were occupied with providing sustenance to those who have renounced. If everyone abandoned worldly life to perform penance, there would be no one left to support them. Thus, the householder's duty of charity is shown to be as vital as the ascetic's penance.
